scope.rates: fleet aggregate across active client lanes; no individual per-Drive rates
scope.rate_denominator: active_elapsed_seconds; excludes boundary observers and idle liveness
scope.cycles: one workload cycle; open/read-or-write/close except four metadata RPCs for churn
scope.data_rpc: successful ordinary filesystem read/write dispatches; truncates excluded
scope.metadata_rpc: successful control dispatches including open/close, truncate, rename and unlink
scope.all_rpc: data plus metadata acknowledgements; idle liveness excluded
scope.replicas: each of ten workers opens every Drive; block-store client instances, not RustFS servers
scope.cpu: eleven frontend process deltas include observers/background; backend container CPU excluded
scope.metric_windows: sequential process boundary captures; no atomic global cut
scope.wall_times: inclusive async elapsed; nested and concurrent spans overlap; no exclusive-cost sum
scope.api_counts: instrumented adapter/SQL/transaction method calls, not wire packets or HTTP attempts
scope.comparability: prior NAPI logical operations exclude open/close and use a different geometry/window
